_note: Tuning numbers for the new-bills pipeline, read once by pipeline/lib/pipeline-config.mjs. Change them here, not in code.

text._note: Printed line numbering (agents/text-norm.mjs). A run of at least min_run numbers, each the one before plus one and min_gap to max_gap characters after it, is line numbering, not a figure.

field_limits._note: Longest a rendered reading field may be, in characters (agents/slots.mjs). thresholds 1300: owner, 30 Oct 2026 (chip definitions with 5-6 specifications).

style_examples._note: Entries shown to the writer as style examples (agents/process-item.mjs): how many, and only those whose mechanism is shorter than this.

dedupe._note: agents/dedupe.mjs: how much of a new bill's opening text is searched for the numbers of tracked bills it names.

escalation._note: agents/budget.mjs: the most sub-keys one escalated item may spread its budget over (a guard against an endless loop, never reached in practice).

new_bills._note: agents/newbill.mjs (owner, 31 Oct 2026): engine "simple" writes a new Congress.gov or LegiScan bill with the writer (role writer) and checks it with the reviewer (role bill_reviewer): code checks with one retry, at most one fix round, then publish, facts-only, or out of scope. Any other value keeps the older generator / validator / referee loop (agents/process-item.mjs). The prompt is agents/newbill-prompt.md.
